notes:
Summary: SlateBridge runs a 20-year archive of longform content (news features, transcripts, scanned OCR) — primary goal is fast, high-recall search across long documents with relevance guarantees and low cost per query. They are embedding-first with a cross-encoder reranker for final pass.

POC scope / asks: 
- Index scale: ~3M documents -> ~9-12M chunks (avg chunk size 3k-6k characters). Expect growth ~20%/yr.
- Latency: 95th perc <200ms for retrieval + rerank OR graceful degrade to <=500ms with fallback.
- Throughput: baseline 20 qps, burst to 60 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.02/query (embeddings+ANN+reranker amortized).
- Data controls: VPC, SSO, audit logs, KMS.

Technical convo highlights: 
- Chunking experiments: team currently using fixed-size 2.5k char chunks with 20% overlap; saw boundary breaks on long transcripts. We recommended hybrid strategy: adaptive semantic-aware chunking using sentence/paragraph boundaries for narrative pieces, fixed token windows for tabular/metadata sections.
- Embeddings: testing two candidates from Redwood catalog (512-d and 1k-d variants). 512-d reduces index size and ANN latency but loses surface-level paraphrase recall in some newswire queries.
- ANN index: evaluating HNSW (memory) vs quantized IVF/PQ for Dedicated; preliminary Faiss IVF-PQ with OPQ reduced index from ~180GB -> ~34GB at 8-bit PQ with 8k centroids, recall drop ~4%. Good cost tradeoff.
- Reranker tuning: using a lightweight cross-encoder reranker only on top-K candidates (K=80 -> K=20 tradeoffs tested). Reranker raises nDCG@10 by ~12% absolute but adds 120-250ms depending on model. We discussed cascaded rerank: cheap lexical filter -> dense ANN -> 1-2 shallow cross-encoders (quantized).
- Caching & prefix reuse: many queries are repeated or slight variants — caching top-50 per user session reduces cost 30%.

POC results (first 2 weeks):
- Indexed ~3.2M chunks (avg 4.1k chars). ANN recall@100: 0.82 (512-d) vs 0.87 (1k-d).
- End-to-end median latency (hosted small test rig): retrieval 45ms, rerank (full cross-encoder) 230ms -> total 275ms. With cascaded reranker (K=20) total ~140ms.
- Cost estimates: hosted_api prototype cost ~$0.035/query including cross-encoder; projected Dedicated with quantized embeddings + cascaded rerank ~ $0.011/query.

- "We need predictable tails — spikes kill UX for editors." — Head of Product
- "If the reranker gives a huge jump in precision we can justify the extra spend, but we need fallbacks." — CTO
